title: Ocean omics coordination network
description: One network that coordinates marine microbial omics observation across programs. One record per file in data/coordination-networks/.

id.description: Stable identifier, also the filename and the URL fragment on the website. Do not change it after publication.

acronym.description: Short name the network is usually known by. Where a network is known by two acronyms, give both separated by ` / `.

network-website.description: Main landing page for the network.

additional-websites.description: Further URLs for the same program, when it is documented in more than one place. The first/canonical URL belongs in the primary website field.

affiliated-institutions.description: Member or partner institutions and programs, as free text.

umbrella-organisation.description: Larger body this network sits under, such as UN Ocean Decade, OBON or GOOS.

status.description: Whether the network is still operating.

established-note.description: Qualifier on the establishment year, for example `initiated` when the network was announced before it began operating.

geographic-scope.description: Region the network covers: `Global`, an ocean basin, a country, or a described area.

data-accessions.description: Public archive accessions, for the few networks that hold data themselves rather than through member programs.

data-accessions-note.description: Anything about data availability that is not itself an accession.

mission-statement.description: One or two sentences on what the network is for, ideally in the network's own words.

notes.description: Anything else worth recording about this network.

accession.description: An INSDC BioProject/study accession (PRJNA/PRJEB/PRJEA/PRJDB), an SRA/ENA/DDBJ accession, a PRIDE dataset (PXD), a GenBank nucleotide accession, or a hyphenated range of either. No archive name, no surrounding text.

contacts.description: People to write to about this network.

note.description: Caveat about reaching this person, e.g. that the address bounced.

publications.description: Example publications, preferably ones showing coordination of omics observation. Bare DOI where one exists; URL as a fallback.

verification.description: Who last checked this record against reality, and when.
